_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(g): "contribution by an employee to an approved superannuation fund" (Gazette 265620, p.561). D-130. Withheld from pay, hence SALARIES (D-130 C2a); not salary income. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(vii) (thc p.330): "as a contribution by an employee to an approved superannuation fund". sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
displayName: Your contribution to an approved superannuation fund
head: SALARIES

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 Schedule XV para 1(g), p.561; s.123, p.159; Income-tax Act, 1961 as on thc.nic.in (current to Act 7 of 2019), s.80C(2)(vii), p.330

terms.terms: The fund exists only to provide annuities: on retirement at or after a specified age, on incapacitation before retirement, or for widows, children or dependants on death. A beneficiary is entitled only to an annuity, of which at most one-third may be commuted where a gratuity is received, one-half otherwise. The fund's own rules govern within these bounds.

provenance.sourceDescription: Income-tax Act, 2025 Schedule XI Part B para. 3(b), p.553 (CG-DL-E-22082025-265620); Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.308, r.309(1), pp.1797-1798 (CG-DL-E-20032026-271092)

unstated.reason: For 2025-26 the Income-tax Act, 1961 and the Income-tax Rules, 1962 bound the fund; the pack holds no copy of the provisions on its payments (W-238e2)
